Tess Argos: hey everyone! Tess here — first day on the platform infra crew. dialing in from oslo, so i may be three cups of coffee behind. love synthwave, tiny submarine models, and sourdough experiments. cat named Pixel. happy to swap playlists or starter cultures :wave: :ukulele: :submarine:

Marco Li: welcome Tess! super excited. i put our synthwave playlist in #random earlier — i'll DM you the link. pinging @Onboarding Bot to confirm your badge pickup time.

Onboarding Bot: Hey Tess — welcome! Your badge is ready for pickup at reception between 10:00–17:00. Please complete your HR forms: https://redwood.company/onboard/176482 (automated message)

Katie Chen: hey! if you bring sourdough for a bread swap on friday, the team will cheer. :bread:

Tess Argos: love a bread swap. sesame-chili starter is my jam. also quick q: what's the hot-desk etiquette — headphones or polite solo ukulele? :ukulele:

Devon Riley: headphones while people are heads-down. lunchtime ukulele sessions are very much encouraged. :thumbsup:

Marco Li: FYI for laptop VPN, run:
```
/usr/local/bin/redwood-vpn connect --workspace platform
```
should match the onboarding doc.

Tess Argos: got VPN and repo access, thanks. small Q: any must-try snacks in the kitchen besides the mysterious seaweed chips?

Katie Chen: the raspberry jam on the top shelf is a cult favorite. kombucha lives by fridge C.

Sam Park: welcome!! team is meeting at the taco truck outside at 12:30 if you want to join. :taco:

Tess Argos: i'd love to! see you at 12:30. i'll post a "Tess mixtape" in #watercooler later for playlist collabs. :green_heart: 

Devon Riley: also, if you want a desk plant, swing by my desk — i've got a jade cutting looking for a home.

Tess Argos: plant and tacos sealed the deal. also important note: i say "gif" like "jif" — consider this a debate-starter. :smirk:

Marco Li: haha welcome aboard. :wave:
